name: Constant Contact
description: Constant Contact is a marketing platform for email Campaigns, contacts, lists, events, SMS, social publishing, landing pages, automation, and reporting.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact Constant Contact Account through Relay-owned server OAuth with only account_read, campaign_data, and offline_access after verifying account and report privileges. Relay serializes complete rotating token-pair replacement and exposes only Account ID/organization, twenty-five content-free Campaign lifecycle summaries, and twenty-five aggregate Campaign Summary Reports; contacts, identity, content, person-level tracking, broader APIs, arbitrary queries, pagination, exports, and writes remain blocked.

providerSetup.blocker: Constant Contact requires Relay to register a confidential V3 application with the exact Railway callback, exact scopes, rotating refresh tokens, and secure client credentials. Railway staging credentials and Owner/Manager acceptance accounts are not configured in this code-only task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, create and review Relay's Constant Contact V3 app with https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/constant-contact/callback and only account_read campaign_data offline_access, choose rotating refresh tokens, configure Railway staging credentials, then verify JWT/token claims, exact Account and privilege binding, all three minimized reads, near-expiry serialized pair rotation, provider revocation plus local disconnect, rate limits, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Constant Contact documents confidential Authorization Code OAuth, Basic-auth form token and refresh requests, 86,400-second access tokens, rate-limited rotating refresh pairs, and Bearer V3 API calls.
Account, Email Campaign, email reporting, and refresh routes require account_read, campaign_data, and offline_access respectively; contact_data and account_update are not required.
The selected reads require account:read, campaign:read, and ui:campaign:metrics; Account Owners and Managers have these privileges while Campaign Creators lack account and report access.
The V3 account, Email Campaign collection, and Email Campaign Summary Report endpoints publish the response fields and bounded limit parameters used by Relay's privacy-minimized wrappers.
